svg.title: NCP ecosystem integration map
svg.desc: Informative ecosystem map for the UNRELEASED 1.0.0-rc.1 candidate. It shows optional adapter dependency direction and the authority boundary for Engram, Haldir, Crebain, Galadriel, Prisoma, and pid-rs. Cortexel has no NCP edge. It is not a release, consumer qualification, or certification claim.

svg.text: AUTHORITY · Crebain remains final software body authority. Direct Engram and Haldir-gated command are mutually exclusive per term.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: MONOTONICITY · Galadriel advice can only preserve or remove Haldir permission. Observers gain no command or lifecycle authority.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: NO EDGE · pid-rs remains protocol-neutral. Cortexel has no NCP package, runtime, documentation-import, or role edge.
